items.text:
Ran out of fuel on the way back from what I would call an otherwise successful salvage haul (3 reactors + a bunch of stuff)
Asked for help from the nearest space station, they dispatched a tug to haul me back to the station.

[b]the tug then proceeds to slam into my ship so hard it kills my hired crew on impact, knocks me out, and I die of hypoxia after the resulting hull breach sucks the rest of the oxygen out[/b]

From what I saw, the tug managed to successfully dock and was at least trying to get me back to the station before I died, so while you can call the tugboat captain many things—“incompetent” comes to mind—you can't say they aren't committed to their craft.

10/10
items.text_zh:
在从一次我会称之为其他方面都成功的打捞返程途中没燃料了（3个反应堆+一堆东西）
向最近的空间站求助，他们派了一艘拖船把我拖回空间站。

[b]然后那艘拖船猛撞上我的船，撞得如此之狠，以至于撞击当场杀死了我雇的船员，把我撞晕，而在由此产生的船体破口把剩下的氧气吸走之后，我死于缺氧[/b]

从我所看到的情况来看，那艘拖船成功对接了，而且至少在我死前还在试图把我带回空间站，所以虽然你可以用很多词来称呼那位拖船船长——“无能”浮现在脑海中——但你不能说他们对自己的手艺不尽心。

10/10
